verdict: 126 leads at $8.91 each — paid is working; the broader build is overdue.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 126 leads at a cost of $8.91 per lead, all through Meta, on $1,122.50 in total spend. Spend roughly doubled in the most recent 7-day stretch and cost per lead rose only modestly (8.35%), which shows the Meta campaigns are still efficient as budget scales — a positive sign. However, lead volume over the last three days of the window dropped sharply, averaging 2 leads per day versus 4.3 the three days prior, so we are watching that closely and will adjust targeting and creative if the softness holds. In parallel, several planned buildout items — including landing pages, search campaigns, and conversion tracking — are behind schedule and being prioritized now; getting those in place is the clearest path to expanding volume beyond what Meta alone can deliver.
